title: King
desc: Raja and his father, who live in Hong Kong, are devastated when an accident leaves the latter on the verge of death. He decides to reunite his father with his grandfather in order to make him happy.

title: Thalapathy
desc: Surya, a courageous man who gets raised in the slums, fights for the rights of the poor. However, he becomes friends with Deva, who hires him as his commander and changes his life completely.

title: Vaali
desc: Deva, a man with a hearing and speech impairment, secretly loves his twin brother's wife, Priya. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

title: Kasethan Kadavulada
desc: Ramu, a young man, ropes his acquaintances into an intricate plan to steal money from his evil stepmother.

title: Natpe Thunai
desc: Prabhakaran, a former hockey player, helps a local team save their ground by training them to win a match against the Pondicherry team. However, a corrupt politician has his eyes set on the ground.

title: Kanden Kadhalai
desc: Sakthivel and Anjali are poles apart, but circumstances bring them together. However, the pair soon part ways as Anjali elopes to meet her true lover.

title: Pathinettu Vayasu Puyaley
desc: Surya, a good-for-nothing young man, gets hit by a car while daydreaming about a girl. When Gayathri takes him to the hospital and saves his life, he falls in love with her.

title: Pathirama Pathukkunga
desc: Sabari, a young man, falls in love with Indra, a college girl, and proposes to her. However, she rejects his proposal as she is engaged, and Sabari befriends her fiance to break their relationship.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kaalamellam Kaathal Vaazhga
desc: A mutual passion for music attracts Kausalya and Jeeva to each other, via phone calls. Over time, their connection grows stronger, and their frequent conversations spark a love story between them.
